inlines.v: AS'PER, adjective [Latin See Asperate.] Rough; rugged. [Little used.] AS'PER, noun [Latin aspiro, to breathe.] In grammar, the Greek accent, importing that the letter over which it is placed ought to be aspirated, or pronounced as if the letter h preceded it. AS'PER, noun A Turkish coin, of which three make a medine. Its value is about a cent and 12 decimals.
